titleSq: Banesë në shitje në Fushë Kosovë
titleEn: Apartment for sale in Fushë Kosovë
descriptionSq:
Ofrohet per shitje banese me siperfaqe 64.2 m², me lokacion ne Rrugen Hajrullah Zymi, Fushe Kosove.
Ndertim nga Aron Bau Residence.
Me orientim nga Perendimi, ka kete renditje te hapesirave te brendshme: qendrim ditor, kuzhine, nje dhome gjumi, nje banjo, nje depo dhe nje ballkon.
Sistemi i ngrohjes eshte elektrik nen dysheme.
Banesa ndodhet ne nje zone te zhvilluar, afer sherbimeve publike dhe private.
descriptionEn:
Apartment for sale with an area of 64.2 m², located on Rruga Hajrullah Zymi, Fushë Kosovë.
Built by Aron Bau Residence.
Facing west, it has the following layout of interior spaces: living room, kitchen, one bedroom, one bathroom, one storage room and one balcony.
It is located on the 7th floor.
The contract is signed at the notary.
The heating system is electric underfloor heating.
The apartment is located in a developed area, close to public and private services.
